intro: Five factions hold the land. Barbarian cities from level {{level}} up belong to the faction holding their zone; lower ones are bandits, loyal to no one.
standingIntro: Attacking a faction's cities lowers your standing with it; a won attack on bandits on its land, and trading with the factions from a city in its lands, raise it. Standing drifts back to neutral over time.
terms: Your cities in its lands trade with the factions at a spread of {{spread}}.
refuses: It won't trade with your cities in its lands.
